Junium, qui existimat vocem esse corruptā in no-
stris libris, scribendúmque Parasangara: vult enim
ita dici, quòd tantū spatii contineret, quantū Paras,
h.e. eques angarus (ut ipse explicat) uno die coficere
potest. Hæc opinio autem Drusio probabilis nō est,
quòd Paras pro equite dictio sit Hebraica; Angarus
autem Persica: copositio verò talis ex voce Persica
& Hebraica nō fit consueta. At verò simpliciter vox

cat. Sic enim Tavasius, Gen. 35. 16. & 48. 7. vocē He-

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are only approximately transcribed; the Syriac lines (Portio, Idem, Modus) are rendered as best read. Several Hebrew/Aramaic forms are uncertain and not marked individually. The word "vox Latina" at the foot is a catchword.
